title: 基础认知看板
description: 按 2026-10-16 录入的 F-011 到 F-023：题材是舞台，情绪是推力。

options.content:
**市场就是题材加情绪（F-011）。** 题材是舞台，情绪是推力。主线要能带动大盘（F-021），来源看想象力、新故事、可信消息、能不能带动全球（F-022）。调整结束会再次点燃，高情绪是对这条主线的正向反馈（F-023），不是利空打过之后的反弹（F-016，那种不能格局）。

冰点问舞台还在不在，火热问这股推力还值不值得等（F-018）。宽标签（国有企业、人工智能）人数多不等于情绪成立，要看涨停原因原文是不是同一件事。仓位水位（F-019）不在库里，看板不编。

panels.title: 最近涨停日

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(date)::text AS "日期" FROM zt_pool

panels.title: 上证涨跌% · 主线能不能带动大盘

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(pct::numeric, 2) AS "涨跌%" FROM index_daily WHERE code='sh000001' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 涨停家数 · 推力

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS "家数" FROM zt_pool WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM zt_pool)

panels.title: 炸板家数 · 分歧

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS "家数" FROM zb_pool WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM zt_pool)

panels.title: 最高连板

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(board_days)::int AS "板" FROM zt_pool WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM zt_pool)

panels.title: 打板成功率% / 溢价%

targets.rawSql: SELECT dbcgl AS "成功率%", dbyll AS "溢价%" FROM sentiment_daily ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 一、舞台：哪些题材在聚集、启动、发酵、高潮、分歧、退潮
龙虎题材阶段（801，已打开的映射。高度：不到 3 板是聚集未完成，破 3 板是启动，4 到 5 板是发酵，破 6 板是高潮）

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM zt_pool),
prev AS (
  SELECT max(cal_date) AS d FROM trade_cal, latest
  WHERE market='SSE' AND is_open=1 AND cal_date < latest.d
),
zt AS (
  SELECT m.sector_name,
         count(DISTINCT z.code) FILTER (WHERE z.date = latest.d) AS zt_today,
         max(z.board_days) FILTER (WHERE z.date = latest.d) AS height,
         count(DISTINCT z.code) FILTER (WHERE z.date = prev.d) AS zt_prev
  FROM stock_sector_map m
  CROSS JOIN latest
  CROSS JOIN prev
  JOIN zt_pool z ON z.code = m.code AND z.date IN (latest.d, prev.d)
  WHERE m.kind='theme' AND m.effective_to IS NULL AND m.sector_code ~ '^801'
  GROUP BY m.sector_name
)
SELECT sector_name AS "题材",
       zt_today AS "今日涨停",
       zt_prev AS "昨日涨停",
       height AS "最高板",
       CASE
         WHEN height >= 6 THEN '高潮'
         WHEN height BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '发酵'
         WHEN height >= 3 AND zt_today >= COALESCE(zt_prev, 0) THEN '启动'
         WHEN zt_today > COALESCE(zt_prev, 0) AND COALESCE(height, 0) < 3 THEN '聚集未完成'
         WHEN zt_today < COALESCE(zt_prev, 0) AND COALESCE(height, 0) >= 3 THEN '分歧'
         WHEN zt_today < COALESCE(zt_prev, 0) THEN '退潮'
         ELSE '观察'
       END AS "阶段"
FROM zt
WHERE zt_today >= 3 OR COALESCE(height, 0) >= 3
ORDER BY zt_today DESC, height DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 25

panels.title: 行业涨停（和题材分开。同名行业不等于同一舞台）

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM zt_pool)
SELECT m.sector_name AS "行业",
       count(DISTINCT z.code) AS "今日涨停",
       max(z.board_days) AS "最高板"
FROM stock_sector_map m
CROSS JOIN latest
JOIN zt_pool z ON z.code = m.code AND z.date = latest.d
WHERE m.kind='industry' AND m.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY m.sector_name
HAVING count(DISTINCT z.code) >= 2
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT z.code) DESC, max(z.board_days) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 二、核对舞台：原因原文是不是同一件事
当日涨停原因原文（按连板高度。口袋标签要看第一句是不是这件事）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT code AS "代码", name AS "名称", board_days AS "连板",
       left(coalesce(theme, reason, ''), 80) AS "原因原文", industry AS "行业"
FROM zt_pool
WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM zt_pool)
ORDER BY board_days DESC NULLS LAST, code
LIMIT 30

panels.title: 炸板（分歧：高度还在但封不住）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT code AS "代码", name AS "名称", board_days AS "连板", break_times AS "开板次数", industry AS "行业"
FROM zb_pool
WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM zt_pool)
ORDER BY board_days DESC NULLS LAST, break_times DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 三、推力：钱往哪里去，火热还值不值得等
题材主力净流入前 12（亿元。正数是还在进）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.sector_name AS "题材",
       round((sum(f.main_net_inflow)/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "净流入亿元",
       count(DISTINCT f.code) AS "有资金流的成分股"
FROM stock_sector_map m
JOIN fund_flow_stock f ON f.code = m.code
WHERE m.kind='theme' AND m.effective_to IS NULL AND m.sector_code ~ '^801'
  AND f.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM fund_flow_stock)
GROUP BY m.sector_name
ORDER BY sum(f.main_net_inflow) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 题材主力净流出前 12（推力在撤）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.sector_name AS "题材",
       round((sum(f.main_net_inflow)/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "净流入亿元"
FROM stock_sector_map m
JOIN fund_flow_stock f ON f.code = m.code
WHERE m.kind='theme' AND m.effective_to IS NULL AND m.sector_code ~ '^801'
  AND f.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM fund_flow_stock)
GROUP BY m.sector_name
ORDER BY sum(f.main_net_inflow) ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 四、路径：恐慌后的点燃、途中微调、利空后的反弹、大跌后的山形
上证收盘（看是单边上行、干脆反弹，还是上上下下的山形）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AS time, close AS "上证"
FROM index_daily
WHERE code='sh000001' AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - 80
ORDER BY date

panels.title: 上证近 10 日：涨跌、成交额（亿元）、涨停家数

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.date AS "日期",
       round(i.pct::numeric, 2) AS "涨跌%",
       round((i.amount/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "成交额亿元",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM zt_pool z WHERE z.date=i.date) AS "涨停",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM zb_pool b WHERE b.date=i.date) AS "炸板"
FROM index_daily i
WHERE i.code='sh000001'
ORDER BY i.date DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: 这张路径怎么读

options.content:
- **F-012** 先跌出恐慌再加速，积压的情绪放开之后能持续一阵。看的是大跌日放量，后面缩量再拉起来。
- **F-013 / F-014** 加速上涨途中的回撤，要同时还有舞台、还没有利空，才是微调。微调后续涨，参与窗口变短。
- **F-015 / F-016** 下跌已经开始，再来一条外部利空，情绪会从犹豫走到一致看空。之后的反弹可以很干脆，但不能格局。
- **F-017** 大跌之后上上下下是敏感期的山形，不是新主升。新舞台要同时更有想象力，而且推力够；舞台差就只是占位。

panels.title: 五、外部：全球共舞，还是外部利空
最近一个外盘日的涨跌（日经、韩国如果源对不上，不要拿来当前提）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS "日期", code AS "代码", name AS "名称", round(close::numeric, 2) AS "收盘", round(pct::numeric, 2) AS "涨跌%"
FROM global_daily
WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM global_daily)
ORDER BY code

panels.title: 当日快讯（只复述盘面的是结果，不是原因）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(msg_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS "时间", left(title, 72) AS "标题"
FROM market_messages
WHERE (msg_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (SELECT max(date) FROM zt_pool)
ORDER BY msg_ts DESC
LIMIT 18

panels.title: 六、库里的基础认知。上面的分档跟着这些陈述走
2026-10-16 录入的宪法层（取每个编号的最新版本）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cognition_id AS "编号", version AS "版本", title AS "标题",
       left(split_part(statement, E'\n', 1), 96) AS "陈述首句"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cognition_id) cognition_id, version, title, statement
  FROM cognition
  WHERE type='constitution' AND status='active'
    AND cognition_id ~ '^F-0(1[1-9]|2[0-3])$'
  ORDER BY cognition_id, version DESC
) s
ORDER BY cognition_id

panels.title: 观势写过的宪法层（F-001 到 F-010，看他后来有没有出新版本）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cognition_id AS "编号", version AS "版本",
       created_at::date AS "写入日", left(title, 28) AS "标题"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cognition_id) cognition_id, version, title, created_at
  FROM cognition
  WHERE type='constitution' AND status='active' AND actor='guanshi'
    AND cognition_id ~ '^F-0'
  ORDER BY cognition_id, version DESC
) s
ORDER BY cognition_id
